description.en: An instrument service mat: a fine locating grid, an open contact and one marked return. The grid echoes declared rules, the break an intercepted tool call, and the terracotta trace the single shared repair allowance.
description.zh: 借用精密仪器检修垫的语言：细密定位栅格、断开的触点、一条标记清楚的返回线。栅格对应声明式规则，断口对应被拦截的工具调用，陶土色回路对应共用的一次修复机会。
